While these options are almost the same as their new counterparts, there are some differences that prevents them being redundant
    
    
    -j, --dump-json                  --print "%()j"
    -F, --list-formats               --print formats_table
    --list-thumbnails                --print thumbnails_table --print playlist:thumbnails_table
    --list-subs                      --print automatic_captions_table --print subtitles_table
    

#### Redundant options

While these options are redundant, they are still expected to be used due to their ease of use
    
    
    --get-description                --print description
    --get-duration                   --print duration_string
    --get-filename                   --print filename
    --get-format                     --print format
    --get-id                         --print id
    --get-thumbnail                  --print thumbnail
    -e, --get-title                  --print title
    -g, --get-url                    --print urls
    --match-title REGEX              --match-filters "title ~= (?i)REGEX"
    --reject-title REGEX             --match-filters "title !~= (?i)REGEX"
    --min-views COUNT                --match-filters "view_count >=? COUNT"
    --max-views COUNT                --match-filters "view_count <=? COUNT"
    --break-on-reject                Use --break-match-filters
    --user-agent UA                  --add-headers "User-Agent:UA"
    --referer URL                    --add-headers "Referer:URL"
    --playlist-start NUMBER          -I NUMBER:
    --playlist-end NUMBER            -I :NUMBER
    --playlist-reverse               -I ::-1
    --no-playlist-reverse            Default
    --no-colors                      --color no_color
    

#### Not recommended

While these options still work, their use is not recommended since there are other alternatives to achieve the same
    
    
    --force-generic-extractor        --ies generic,default
    --exec-before-download CMD       --exec "before_dl:CMD"
    --no-exec-before-download        --no-exec
    --all-formats                    -f all
    --all-subs                       --sub-langs all --write-subs
    --print-json                     -j --no-simulate
    --autonumber-size NUMBER         Use string formatting, e.g. %(autonumber)03d
    --autonumber-start NUMBER        Use internal field formatting like %(autonumber+NUMBER)s
    --id                             -o "%(id)s.%(ext)s"
    --metadata-from-title FORMAT     --parse-metadata "%(title)s:FORMAT"
    --hls-prefer-native              --downloader "m3u8:native"
    --hls-prefer-ffmpeg              --downloader "m3u8:ffmpeg"
    --list-formats-old               --compat-options list-formats (Alias: --no-list-formats-as-table)
    --list-formats-as-table          --compat-options -list-formats [Default]
    --geo-bypass                     --xff "default"
    --no-geo-bypass                  --xff "never"
    --geo-bypass-country CODE        --xff CODE
    --geo-bypass-ip-block IP_BLOCK   --xff IP_BLOCK
    

#### Developer options

These options are not intended to be used by the end-user
    
    
    --test                           Download only part of video for testing extractors
    --load-pages                     Load pages dumped by --write-pages
    --allow-unplayable-formats       List unplayable formats also
    --no-allow-unplayable-formats    Default
    

#### Old aliases

These are aliases that are no longer documented for various reasons
    
    
    --clean-infojson                 --clean-info-json
    --force-write-download-archive   --force-write-archive
    --no-clean-infojson              --no-clean-info-json
    --no-split-tracks                --no-split-chapters
    --no-write-srt                   --no-write-subs
    --prefer-unsecure                --prefer-insecure
    --rate-limit RATE                --limit-rate RATE
    --split-tracks                   --split-chapters
    --srt-lang LANGS                 --sub-langs LANGS
    --trim-file-names LENGTH         --trim-filenames LENGTH
    --write-srt                      --write-subs
    --yes-overwrites                 --force-overwrites
    

#### Sponskrub Options

Support for [SponSkrub](https://github.com/faissaloo/SponSkrub) has been removed in favor of the `--sponsorblock` options
    
    
    --sponskrub                      --sponsorblock-mark all
    --no-sponskrub                   --no-sponsorblock
    --sponskrub-cut                  --sponsorblock-remove all
    --no-sponskrub-cut               --sponsorblock-remove -all
    --sponskrub-force                Not applicable
    --no-sponskrub-force             Not applicable
    --sponskrub-location             Not applicable
    --sponskrub-args                 Not applicable
    

#### No longer supported

These options may no longer work as intended
    
    
    --prefer-avconv                  avconv is not officially supported by yt-dlp (Alias: --no-prefer-ffmpeg)
    --prefer-ffmpeg                  Default (Alias: --no-prefer-avconv)
    -C, --call-home                  Not implemented
    --no-call-home                   Default
    --include-ads                    No longer supported
    --no-include-ads                 Default
    --write-annotations              No supported site has annotations now
    --no-write-annotations           Default
    --avconv-location                Removed alias for --ffmpeg-location
    --cn-verification-proxy URL      Removed alias for --geo-verification-proxy URL
    --dump-headers                   Removed alias for --print-traffic
    --dump-intermediate-pages        Removed alias for --dump-pages
    --youtube-skip-dash-manifest     Removed alias for --extractor-args "youtube:skip=dash" (Alias: --no-youtube-include-dash-manifest)
    --youtube-skip-hls-manifest      Removed alias for --extractor-args "youtube:skip=hls" (Alias: --no-youtube-include-hls-manifest)
    --youtube-include-dash-manifest  Default (Alias: --no-youtube-skip-dash-manifest)
    --youtube-include-hls-manifest   Default (Alias: --no-youtube-skip-hls-manifest)
    --youtube-print-sig-code         Removed testing functionality
    --dump-user-agent                No longer supported
    --xattr-set-filesize             No longer supported
    --compat-options seperate-video-versions  No longer needed
    --compat-options no-youtube-prefer-utc-upload-date  No longer supported
    

#### Removed

These options were deprecated since 2014 and have now been entirely removed
    
    
    -A, --auto-number                -o "%(autonumber)s-%(id)s.%(ext)s"
    -t, -l, --title, --literal       -o "%(title)s-%(id)s.%(ext)s"

# Supported sites

Below is a list of all extractors that are currently included with yt-dlp. If a site is not listed here, it might still be supported by yt-dlp's embed extraction or generic extractor. Not all sites listed here are guaranteed to work; websites are constantly changing and sometimes this breaks yt-dlp's support for them. The only reliable way to check if a site is supported is to try it.

### Description of your _pull request_ and other information

Not sure what to call this.

This code was originally from [#682](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/pull/682).

This PR adds:

  * fallback player url extraction when it fails to be extracted from the webpage
  * don't download js player unnecessarily for clients that don't require it
  * try extract js player url from any additional client configs
  * ability to skip the js player usage/download (inc iframe fallback). 
    * This overrides the clients' config setting.
    * **This can be enabled with`--extractor-args youtube:player_skip=js`**
    * Formats that require signature decryption will be skipped automatically (since no player url)
  * ability to skip the webpage download 
    * **This can be enabled with`--extractor-args youtube:player_skip=webpage`**



KNOWN ISSUES:

  * authentication for multi-channel accounts and multi-account cookies may not work correctly if the webpage (and any additional client configs) are not downloaded.



TODO:

  * documentation
  * `player_skip=js` or something else?

Some example usage

  1. `--extractor-args youtube:player_skip=webpage,configs,js;player_client=android,web`
     * This makes extraction solely rely on the API - so no webpage downloads. Might help with avoiding 429s in some situations.
     * Since the web client usually needs the player js, formats from the web client requiring signature decryption will be skipped.
     * 3 initial API requests (android, web, initial data)

~~2.`--extractor-args youtube:player_skip=webpage,configs,js;player_client=android`  
\- Same as above, but without the web client (some minor metadata may be missed - be sure to check)  
\- 2 initial API requests (android, initial data)~~ **Do not use - missing metadata** ~~3.`--extractor-args youtube:player_skip=webpage;player_client=android`  
\- since the android client doesn't require the player js, this is the same as 2.~~ **Do not use - missing metadata**

  4. `--extractor-args youtube:player_skip=webpage`
     * basically forces fallbacks as if the webpage failed to download.
     * player url should be downloaded using the iframe API fallback (once, only if required)
  5. `--extractor-args youtube:player_skip=webpage;player_client=web_music`
     * config webpage for web_music is downloaded (thus player js details), so web formats should work correctly.

Not recommended:

  1. `--extractor-args youtube:player_skip=webpage,configs,js;player_client=web`
     * In some cases you'll get a no formats error (formats from the web client requiring signature decryption will be skipped).
  2. `--extractor-args youtube:player_skip=js;player_client=web`

|  |  * `player_skip`: Skip some network requests that are generally needed for robust extraction. One or more of `configs` (skip client configs), `webpage` (skip initial webpage), `js` (skip js player). While these options can help reduce the number of requests needed or avoid some rate-limiting, they could cause some issues. See [#860](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/pull/860) for more details

Expand Up | @@ -1436,7 +1436,10 @@ The following extractors use this feature:  
|  |  * **youtube**  
|  |  * `skip`: `hls` or `dash` (or both) to skip download of the respective manifests  
|  |  * `player_client`: Clients to extract video data from. The main clients are `web`, `android`, `ios`, `mweb`. These also have `_music`, `_embedded`, `_agegate`, and `_creator` variants (Eg: `web_embedded`) (`mweb` has only `_agegate`). By default, `android,web` is used, but the agegate and creator variants are added as required for age-gated videos. Similarly the music variants are added for `music.youtube.com` urls. You can also use `all` to use all the clients  
|  |  * `player_skip`: `configs` - skip any requests for client configs and use defaults  
|  |  * `player_skip`:  
|  |  \- `configs` - skip any requests for client configs and use defaults  
|  |  \- `webpage` - skip request for the initial webpage  
|  |  \- `js` - skip request & usage of the js player file for all clients

Expand Up | @@ -1436,7 +1436,7 @@ The following extractors use this feature:  
|  |  * **youtube**  
|  |  * `skip`: `hls` or `dash` (or both) to skip download of the respective manifests  
|  |  * `player_client`: Clients to extract video data from. The main clients are `web`, `android`, `ios`, `mweb`. These also have `_music`, `_embedded`, `_agegate`, and `_creator` variants (Eg: `web_embedded`) (`mweb` has only `_agegate`). By default, `android,web` is used, but the agegate and creator variants are added as required for age-gated videos. Similarly the music variants are added for `music.youtube.com` urls. You can also use `all` to use all the clients  
|  |  * `player_skip`: `configs` \- skip any requests for client configs and use defaults  
|  |  * `player_skip`: Skip some network requests that are generally needed for robust extraction. One or more of `configs` (skip client configs), `webpage` (skip initial webpage), `js` (skip js player). While these options can help reduce the number of requests needed or avoid some rate-limiting, they could cause some issues. See [#860](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/pull/860) for more details  
|  |  * `include_live_dash`: Include live dash formats (These formats don't download properly)  
|  |  * `comment_sort`: `top` or `new` (default) - choose comment sorting mode (on YouTube's side).  
|  |  * `max_comments`: Maximum amount of comments to download (default all).

Expand Up | @@ -1436,7 +1436,10 @@ The following extractors use this feature:  
|  |  * **youtube**  
|  |  * `skip`: `hls` or `dash` (or both) to skip download of the respective manifests  
|  |  * `player_client`: Clients to extract video data from. The main clients are `web`, `android`, `ios`, `mweb`. These also have `_music`, `_embedded`, `_agegate`, and `_creator` variants (Eg: `web_embedded`) (`mweb` has only `_agegate`). By default, `android,web` is used, but the agegate and creator variants are added as required for age-gated videos. Similarly the music variants are added for `music.youtube.com` urls. You can also use `all` to use all the clients  
|  |  * `player_skip`: `configs` - skip any requests for client configs and use defaults  
|  |  * `player_skip`:  
|  |  \- `configs` - skip any requests for client configs and use defaults  
|  |  \- `webpage` - skip request for the initial webpage  
|  |  \- `js` - skip request & usage of the js player file for all clients

  * I've read the [**NO AI / NO LLM POLICY**](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#no-ai--no-llm-policy) and understand I may be blocked from the repository if it is violated
  * I'm reporting that yt-dlp is broken on a **supported** site

  * I've checked that all URLs and arguments with special characters are [properly quoted or escaped](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/wiki/FAQ#video-url-contains-an-ampersand--and-im-getting-some-strange-output-1-2839-or-v-is-not-recognized-as-an-internal-or-external-command)

### Region

_No response_

### Provide a description that is worded well enough to be understood

When I try to download a video, using an iframe URL, such as [https://vk.com/video_ext.php?oid=-24139285&id=456276595](https://vk.com/video_ext.php?oid=-24139285&id=456276595) — I get an error "Unable to extract player params". For the corresponding web page, in this case <https://vkvideo.ru/video-24139285_456276595> — downloading works fine.

### Provide verbose output that clearly demonstrates the problem

  * Run **your** yt-dlp command with **-vU** flag added (`yt-dlp -vU <your command line>`)
  * If using API, add `'verbose': True` to `YoutubeDL` params instead
  * Copy the WHOLE output (starting with `[debug] Command-line config`) and insert it below

[bashonly](https://github.com/bashonly)on Aug 20, 2026

Workaround: If you're passing logged-in cookies to yt-dlp, try without cookies. If you're getting the error without cookies, then you'll need use a [PO token provider](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/wiki/PO-Token-Guide) and the `mweb` client or (if logged-in) `web_creator` client.

This is a side effect of [#17389](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/17389). The fix for that issue will also fix this one.

### Checklist

  * I've read the [**NO AI / NO LLM POLICY**](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#no-ai--no-llm-policy) and understand I may be blocked from the repository if it is violated
  * I'm reporting that yt-dlp is broken on a **supported** site
  * I've verified that I have **updated yt-dlp to nightly or master** ([update instructions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp#update-channels))
  * I've checked that all provided URLs are playable in a browser with the same IP and same login details
  * I've checked that all URLs and arguments with special characters are [properly quoted or escaped](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/wiki/FAQ#video-url-contains-an-ampersand--and-im-getting-some-strange-output-1-2839-or-v-is-not-recognized-as-an-internal-or-external-command)
  * I've searched [known issues](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/3766), [the FAQ](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/wiki/FAQ), and the [bugtracker](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues?q=is%3Aissue%20-label%3Aspam%20%20) for similar issues **including closed ones**. DO NOT post duplicates
  * I've read about [sharing account credentials](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#are-you-willing-to-share-account-details-if-needed) and I'm willing to share it if required



### Region

_No response_

### Provide a description that is worded well enough to be understood

yt-dlp does not recognize the name of the default subtitle format for vkvideo.ru and requires to manually specify "vtt". The format in question seems to be vtt, just under a different name.

It would be more convenient, if yt-dlp simply saved the subtitles with the nonstandard name. Or replaced the extension with the correct one, when it is possible to determine. Or automatically advanced to the next format in the list, when it cannot save the default one.

### Provide verbose output that clearly demonstrates the problem

  * Run **your** yt-dlp command with **-vU** flag added (`yt-dlp -vU <your command line>`)
  * If using API, add `'verbose': True` to `YoutubeDL` params instead
  * Copy the WHOLE output (starting with `[debug] Command-line config`) and insert it below

## Description

[](https://github.com/pukkandan)

[pukkandan](https://github.com/pukkandan)

opened [on May 17, 2022](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/3766#issue-1238299309)

Issue body actions

Some known common issues. Make sure to always check this before opening issues. **Duplicates of these will be strictly treated as spam!**

**Useful issue tracker filters:**

[[Core Issues]](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues?q=is%3Aopen+is%3Aissue+label%3Aenhancement%2Cbug%2Ccore%3Adownloader%2Ccore%3Apost-processor%2Ccore%3Aextractor%2Ccore%3Anetworking%2Ccore%3Acookies) [[Site Issues]](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues?q=is%3Aopen+is%3Aissue+label%3Asite-request%2Csite-enhancement%2Csite-bug) [[YouTube issues]](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues?q=is%3Aopen+is%3Aissue+label%3Asite%3Ayoutube) [[Good issues for new devs]](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues?q=is%3Aopen+is%3Aissue+label%3A%22gateway-issue%22)

## High priority issues

  * **[[Youtube] ERROR: Video unavailable. Playback on other websites has been disabled by the video owner (web_embedded player response playability status: UNPLAYABLE) #17497](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/17497)**
  * **[[Youtube] ERROR: The page needs to be reloaded (tv_downgraded player response playability status: UNPLAYABLE) #17389](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/17389)**
  * [[Youtube] Only format 18 (360p) is available for age-restricted videos #17542](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/17542)



## Intractable issues

  * **[[YouTube] This content isn't available, try again later. #11426](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/11426)**
    * You are exceeding the rate limit. Refer to [the wiki on how to avoid](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/wiki/Extractors#this-content-isnt-available-try-again-later).
  * **[Passing Youtube cookies doesn't seem to work; cookies are being invalidated quickly #8227](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/8227)**
    * [How to effectively export YouTube cookies](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/wiki/Extractors#exporting-youtube-cookies)
  * **[[youtube] Sign in to confirm you’re not a bot #10128](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/10128)**
    * Your IP has been blocked by YouTube while you are logged out. You can [pass logged-in cookies](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/wiki/Extractors#exporting-youtube-cookies); however, doing so may get your account blocked. The safer solution is to use a different IP.
    * To prevent this, [try using a PO Token provider](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/wiki/PO-Token-Guide), though it will not help if your IP is already blocked.
  * **[[youtube] "Video unavailable" with cookies - YouTube blocking accounts from web #10085](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/10085)**
    * Your account has been blocked by YouTube, or the video is not available in your region.
    * Avoid passing cookies, or add a [sleep delay](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp#workarounds) to each download.
  * **[[Youtube] Immediate HTTP Error 403 on download #11868](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/11868)**
    * Try using `--force-ipv4`, try using yt-dlp from a different IP address (e.g. disable your VPN), try using logged-in cookies if you were using yt-dlp logged-out, or try using yt-dlp without cookies if you were using logged-in cookies

    * Use `-S proto:https` or `--extractor-args "youtube:player_client=default,-ios"`
  * [`--cookies-from-browser` "Permission denied" errors when Chrome/chromium-based browser is open in Windows #7271](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/7271)
    * Try after closing chrome completely OR
    * Launch chrome from command line w/ `chrome.exe --disable-features=LockProfileCookieDatabase`
    * Alternatively, you can [install](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp#installing-plugins) the [ChomeCookieUnlock yt-dlp plugin](https://github.com/seproDev/yt-dlp-ChromeCookieUnlock)
  * [`--cookies-from-browser`: WARNING: failed to decrypt with DPAPI / ERROR: 'NoneType' object has no attribute 'decode' #10927](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/10927)
  * [[youtube] Is downloading a livestream in 1440p or 2160p no longer available? #11262](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/11262)
  * [[Youtube] 8k VR180 SBS videos no longer available #9903](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/9903)
    * Use `--extractor-arg "youtube:player_client=android_vr,default"`
  * [[Youtube] throttling and inconsistent speed in Russia #10443](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/10443)
    * [Workarounds](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/10443#issuecomment-2248940967)
  * [[Discord bot] Music stops in the middle #8854](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/8854)
  * [[youtube] Endless "Incomplete data received" when downloading playlist #10394](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/10394)
    * Don't use `--extractor-retries infinite`
  * [FFMPEG "Invalid data found when processing input" on live/post-live/dash videos (duplicate ftyp) #8641](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/8641)
    * Regression in ffmpeg 6.1. Upgrade to ffmpeg 6.1.1 or to [master build](https://github.com/yt-dlp/FFmpeg-Builds/releases) revision `N-112916` or later
  * [[youtube] "Invalid data found when processing input" / ffmpeg errors on HDR VP9 in mp4 #7541](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/7541)
    * ffmpeg bug. Upgrade to ffmpeg 7.0.1 or to the latest [master build](https://github.com/yt-dlp/FFmpeg-Builds/releases)
  * [`--mark-watched` fails with urlopen error #8149](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/8149)
    * Disable pi-hole or whitelist `s.youtube.com`
  * [Chapter Embedding Results in Unnamed Chapters When Using Recent FFmpeg Builds #6859](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/6859)
    * ffmpeg regression. Use <https://github.com/yt-dlp/FFmpeg-Builds> or upgrade to 6.1.1 or newer
  * [yt-dlp is detected as a virus #25](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/25)
    * It's a false positive. Complain to your vendor. There is nothing we can do
  * [Incomplete Data Recieved #1787](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/1787)
    * Broken from Youtube's side. If downloading comments, use `-i` to ignore the error
  * [Wrong year in metadata in M4A, MP4, FLAC format #3087](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/3087)
    * Workaround: `--parse-metadata "%(release_year,upload_date).4s:(?P<meta_date>.+)"`
  * [pyinstaller temp files are not cleaned up when using yt-dlp.exe with mpv #10294](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/10294)
  * [Long Start-Up Time for `yt-dlp_macos` #10425](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/10425)
  * [`--download-sections` / ffmpeg fails to seek in a 26+ hour long Twitch m3u8 #5372](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/5372)
  * [Using proxy and `--download-sections`/ ffmpeg fails with HTTP Error 400/401/403 #12915](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/12915)



# FAQ

See <https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/wiki/FAQ>

  * **[How to avoid Youtube's new "Super Resolution" AI-upscaled formats #15325](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/15325)**
  * **[Getting deno to work in Termux. #15095 (comment)](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/15095#issuecomment-3544324838)**
    * Run a full Termux upgrade with `pkg update && pkg upgrade` before `pkg install deno`
  * **[[YouTube] Enhanced bitrate no longer available to download? #14133 (comment)](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/14133#issuecomment-3217679575)**
  * [**Filename too long**](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/1136#issuecomment-932077195)
    * Use `-o "%(title).150B [%(id)s].%(ext)s"`
  * **[[YouTube]`--write-comments`: "Incomplete data received. Giving up after 3 retries" warnings #15435](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/15435)**
  * **[twitter: No video could be found in this tweet #14742](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/14742)**
  * [[Question] odd ba* format selection? #979 (comment)](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/979#issuecomment-919629354)
    * Generally do not use `ba*`
  * [Fix playlist_index's inconsistent behavior #302](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/pull/302)
    * Check `playlist_autonumber` and `--compat-option playlist-index`
  * [yt-dlp python module not compiling with pyinstaller #3845](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/3845)
    * Use `bundle/pyinstaller.py`
  * [Subtitle file is not deleted after being embedded #630 (comment)](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/630#issuecomment-893659460)
    * Use `--compat-option no-keep-subs`
  * [`--download-sections`/`--sponsorblock-remove` does not cut at exact point #4216](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/4216) / [YouTube Clip Downloads have unintented extra beginning part with no video #5080](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/5080)
    * Use `--force-keyframes-at-cuts`
  * [Duplicating pull request from youtube-dl to yt-dlp #4202](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/4202)
  * [How to check in browser if the video is DRM protected](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/4062#issuecomment-1153474056)
  * [\--cookies-from-browser for a chrome/firefox like browser or non-default install location #2903](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/2903)
  * [What are yt-dlp's error codes? #4262 (comment)](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/4262#issuecomment-1173133105)
  * [Extractor option `language` for `crunchyrollbeta` #4640](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/4640)
  * [Ability to strip Emoji from downloaded file  #4836](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/4836) / [File names use "full-width" special characters: '？' vs '?' #5014](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/5014)
  * [[Youtube] Extract exact timestamps #1803](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/1803)
  * [[Feature Request] Crop to square thumbnail when embedding in MP3s #429 (comment)](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/429#issuecomment-2282554440)
  * Download only videos with subtitles 
    * `--parse-metadata "%(subtitles.\:.0.ext|)s:^(?!\[\])(?P<has_subs>.)" -v --match-filter has_subs`
  * [How do I rename previously-downloaded files with nothing but the youtube video ID? #5692](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/5692)
  * Remove specific fields from info-json - [[Suggestion] Redact `formats` in info json with an option #455 (comment)](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/455#issuecomment-1367741786)
  * About subtitles in mp4 container - [Convert webvtt subtitles in mp4 into useable format #5833 (comment)](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/5833#issuecomment-1358246240)
  * [Find the API option for a CLI argument #5859 (comment)](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/5859#issuecomment-1363938900)
    * Use <https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/devscripts/cli_to_api.py>
  * [[YouTube] `youtube:skip=translated_subs` doesn't work for some videos. #3875](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/3875)

The latest stable version (stable@2027.07.04) does this:
    
    
    $ yt-dlp "https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=93jxWV0PXRQ"
    [youtube] Extracting URL: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=93jxWV0PXRQ
    [youtube] 93jxWV0PXRQ: Downloading webpage

    [info] 93jxWV0PXRQ: Downloading 1 format(s): 400+251
    ERROR: unable to download video data: HTTP Error 403: Forbidden
    

I'm in the US. The video is accessible through a non-logged-in browser.

### Checklist

  * I'm reporting that yt-dlp is broken on a **supported** site
  * I've verified that I have **updated yt-dlp to nightly or master** ([update instructions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp#update-channels))
  * I've checked that all provided URLs are playable in a browser with the same IP and same login details
  * I've checked that all URLs and arguments with special characters are [properly quoted or escaped](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/wiki/FAQ#video-url-contains-an-ampersand--and-im-getting-some-strange-output-1-2839-or-v-is-not-recognized-as-an-internal-or-external-command)
  * I've searched [known issues](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/3766), [the FAQ](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/wiki/FAQ), and the [bugtracker](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues?q=is%3Aissue%20-label%3Aspam%20%20) for similar issues **including closed ones**. DO NOT post duplicates
  * I've read the [policy against AI/LLM contributions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#automated-contributions-ai--llm-policy) and understand I may be blocked from the repository if it is violated
  * I've read about [sharing account credentials](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#are-you-willing-to-share-account-details-if-needed) and I'm willing to share it if required



### Region

United States

### Provide a description that is worded well enough to be understood

I found that one livestream download keeps unexpectedly ending despite the stream continuing. This has happened on two different live streams from on [this channel](https://www.youtube.com/@courtroom3386) today. When trying to resume, it indicates it was already downloaded, so I have to delete the prematurely completed file for yt-dlp to grab and download it again, only for it to prematurely end again while the live stream keeps broadcasting.

This is currently happening on this video: <https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=de3STw8r6mo>

I captured debug logs, which are copied below; the download had ended prematurely, and it's still streaming/live at the same URL as I write this.

I download many other live streams from other channels that don't experience this issue, but for some reason, multiple videos on this channel keep downloading early, requiring me to delete the downloaded incomplete file mp4 file and manually download again using the same command.

### Provide verbose output that clearly demonstrates the problem

  * Run **your** yt-dlp command with **-vU** flag added (`yt-dlp -vU <your command line>`)
  * If using API, add `'verbose': True` to `YoutubeDL` params instead
  * Copy the WHOLE output (starting with `[debug] Command-line config`) and insert it below

## Description

[](https://github.com/iceame01)

Issue body actions

### Checklist

  * I'm reporting a bug unrelated to a specific site
  * I've verified that I have **updated yt-dlp to nightly or master** ([update instructions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp#update-channels))
  * I've searched [known issues](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/3766), [the FAQ](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/wiki/FAQ), and the [bugtracker](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues?q=is%3Aissue%20-label%3Aspam%20%20) for similar issues **including closed ones**. DO NOT post duplicates
  * I've read the [policy against AI/LLM contributions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#automated-contributions-ai--llm-policy) and understand I may be blocked from the repository if it is violated



### Provide a description that is worded well enough to be understood

Hi, I have an issue where yt-dlp cannot fetch the premium quality format (721) for YouTube membership videos, even when using account cookies.

I can watch the premium quality format (721) in my browser. However, yt-dlp only lists formats up to 399 (standard 1080p) and fails to detect or download the 721 format even using my account cookie.

For regular(non-membership) videos, using the exact same cookies, yt-dlp works perfectly and can detect and download the 721 format without any issues.

### Provide verbose output that clearly demonstrates the problem

  * Run **your** yt-dlp command with **-vU** flag added (`yt-dlp -vU <your command line>`)
  * If using API, add `'verbose': True` to `YoutubeDL` params instead
  * Copy the WHOLE output (starting with `[debug] Command-line config`) and insert it below

### Checklist

  * I'm reporting that yt-dlp is broken on a **supported** site
  * I've verified that I have **updated yt-dlp to nightly or master** ([update instructions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp#update-channels))
  * I've checked that all provided URLs are playable in a browser with the same IP and same login details
  * I've checked that all URLs and arguments with special characters are [properly quoted or escaped](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/wiki/FAQ#video-url-contains-an-ampersand--and-im-getting-some-strange-output-1-2839-or-v-is-not-recognized-as-an-internal-or-external-command)
  * I've searched [known issues](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/3766), [the FAQ](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/wiki/FAQ), and the [bugtracker](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues?q=is%3Aissue%20-label%3Aspam%20%20) for similar issues **including closed ones**. DO NOT post duplicates
  * I've read the [policy against AI/LLM contributions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#automated-contributions-ai--llm-policy) and understand I may be blocked from the repository if it is violated
  * I've read about [sharing account credentials](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#are-you-willing-to-share-account-details-if-needed) and I'm willing to share it if required



### Region

Global

### Provide a description that is worded well enough to be understood

When downloading YouTube livestream using `--live-from-start`, I noticed that sooner or later the download threads for A/V will crash due to
    
    
    ERROR: Did not get any data blocks
      File "threading.py", line 973, in _bootstrap
      File "threading.py", line 1016, in _bootstrap_inner
      File "threading.py", line 953, in run
      File "concurrent\futures\thread.py", line 83, in _worker
      File "concurrent\futures\thread.py", line 58, in run
      File "yt_dlp\downloader\fragment.py", line 490, in _download_fragment
      File "yt_dlp\downloader\fragment.py", line 462, in download_fragment
      File "yt_dlp\downloader\fragment.py", line 124, in _download_fragment
      File "yt_dlp\downloader\common.py", line 480, in download
      File "yt_dlp\downloader\http.py", line 363, in real_download
      File "yt_dlp\downloader\http.py", line 329, in download
      File "yt_dlp\YoutubeDL.py", line 1154, in report_error
      File "yt_dlp\YoutubeDL.py", line 1082, in trouble
    

And after both threads crashed, the download will stop and a broken, incomplete file is the result, for obvious reason.

This will not happen immediately but given the stream is longer enough (say, >1 hr), it will eventually happen in my 4 times using it lately.

Below is my current download where one of the DL thread already crashed （f140) but not the other (f137), yet.

# Fail to resume download after Http error 416 #12994

Fail to resume download after Http error 416#12994

## Description

[](https://github.com/YuriiMaiboroda)

[YuriiMaiboroda](https://github.com/YuriiMaiboroda)

opened [on Apr 23, 2025](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/12994#issue-3015353889)

Issue body actions

### Checklist

  * I'm reporting a bug unrelated to a specific site
  * I've verified that I have **updated yt-dlp to nightly or master** ([update instructions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp#update-channels))
  * I've searched [known issues](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/3766), [the FAQ](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/wiki/FAQ), and the [bugtracker](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues?q=is%3Aissue%20-label%3Aspam%20%20) for similar issues **including closed ones**. DO NOT post duplicates



### Provide a description that is worded well enough to be understood

If a 416 response is received when attempting to download a file via `HttpFD`, a second attempt is made to determine the current length of the file:
    
    
                except HTTPError as err:
                    if err.status == 416:
                        # Unable to resume (requested range not satisfiable)
                        try:
                            # Open the connection again without the range header
                            ctx.data = self.ydl.urlopen(
                                Request(url, request_data, headers))

However, if the `headers` object already contains a `Range` value, it will be included in the second request as well. As a result, another 416 error will be returned and the download will fail.

Since `headers` is an instance of `HTTPHeaderDict`, in the following code
    
    
                request = Request(url, request_data, headers)
                has_range = range_start is not None
                if has_range:
                    request.headers['Range'] = f'bytes={int(range_start)}-{int_or_none(range_end) or ""}'

the `Range` header is added not only to the `request` object but also modifies the original `headers` object. This happens because when the `request` is created, it stores the original `headers` object instead of creating a copy:
    
    
        @headers.setter
        def headers(self, new_headers: Mapping):
            """Replaces headers of the request. If not a HTTPHeaderDict, it will be converted to one."""
            if isinstance(new_headers, HTTPHeaderDict):
                self._headers = new_headers
            elif isinstance(new_headers, Mapping):
                self._headers = HTTPHeaderDict(new_headers)
            else:
                raise TypeError('headers must be a mapping')

But even if the setter performed copying, that still wouldn't guarantee the absence of `Range` in `headers`, because this value could have been passed via `info_dict['http_headers']`.

So I suggest, before making the second request, explicitly calling `headers.pop('Range', None)`.

### Provide verbose output that clearly demonstrates the problem

  * Run **your** yt-dlp command with **-vU** flag added (`yt-dlp -vU <your command line>`)
  * If using API, add `'verbose': True` to `YoutubeDL` params instead
  * Copy the WHOLE output (starting with `[debug] Command-line config`) and insert it below

### DO NOT REMOVE OR SKIP THE ISSUE TEMPLATE

  * I understand that I will be **blocked** if I _intentionally_ remove or skip any mandatory* field



### Checklist

  * I'm reporting that yt-dlp is broken on a **supported** site
  * I've verified that I have **updated yt-dlp to nightly or master** ([update instructions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp#update-channels))
  * I've checked that all provided URLs are playable in a browser with the same IP and same login details
  * I've checked that all URLs and arguments with special characters are [properly quoted or escaped](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/wiki/FAQ#video-url-contains-an-ampersand--and-im-getting-some-strange-output-1-2839-or-v-is-not-recognized-as-an-internal-or-external-command)
  * I've searched [known issues](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/3766) and the [bugtracker](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues?q=) for similar issues **including closed ones**. DO NOT post duplicates
  * I've read the [guidelines for opening an issue](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#opening-an-issue)
  * I've read about [sharing account credentials](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#are-you-willing-to-share-account-details-if-needed) and I'm willing to share it if required



### Region

US

### Provide a description that is worded well enough to be understood

For a certain period of time after a YouTube live stream ends, the m4a audio is only available as a DASH stream. It eventually gets processed into HTTP. This means it's not really possible to provide a url with a DASH stream. It needs to be caught by monitoring a live stream and downloading the m4a audio DASH stream right after it ends. I don't have a url that currently repros.

The recent regression (which could be a YT change) is that such downloads end up exactly half the expected length and when played (e.g. VLC) are silent.

### Provide verbose output that clearly demonstrates the problem

  * Run **your** yt-dlp command with **-vU** flag added (`yt-dlp -vU <your command line>`)
  * If using API, add `'verbose': True` to `YoutubeDL` params instead
  * Copy the WHOLE output (starting with `[debug] Command-line config`) and insert it below

## Description

[](https://github.com/aik099)

[aik099](https://github.com/aik099)

opened [on Mar 21, 2025](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/12687#issue-2938100781)

Issue body actions

### Checklist

  * I'm reporting a bug unrelated to a specific site
  * I've verified that I have **updated yt-dlp to nightly or master** ([update instructions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp#update-channels))
  * I've searched [known issues](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/3766), [the FAQ](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/wiki/FAQ), and the [bugtracker](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues?q=is%3Aissue%20-label%3Aspam%20%20) for similar issues **including closed ones**. DO NOT post duplicates



### Provide a description that is worded well enough to be understood

When segments of an MPD file point to the same URL, then a downloaded file is larger by segment count in % (e.g. 5 segments = 500% larger file).

For example, the <https://edge-ams-1.kinescopecdn.net/3eda89a1-463a-4a4b-a8a1-22c353c83ed6/videos/8337640b-126d-4d11-9384-c465cc42f704/assets/b90ade6c-6974-4766-b103-37bf5040f5e1/720.mp4> (built by hand based on below-provided MPD file) is **4.4MB** in size.

If I ask for yt-dlp to download the best quality based on a given MPD file, then it will produce **17.6MB** file (the **300% larger** , which might be because it downloads the same file from each of the 3 segments).

MPD file sample (URL: `https://example.com/master.mpd` is a dummy one, which supposed to have below file on it):
    
    
    <MPD mediaPresentationDuration="PT9.533S" minBufferTime="PT4.000S" profiles="urn:mpeg:dash:profile:isoff-on-demand:2011" type="static" xmlns="urn:mpeg:dash:schema:mpd:2011">

                    <BaseURL>https://edge-ams-1.kinescopecdn.net/3eda89a1-463a-4a4b-a8a1-22c353c83ed6/videos/8337640b-126d-4d11-9384-c465cc42f704/assets/b90ade6c-6974-4766-b103-37bf5040f5e1/</BaseURL>

## Description

[](https://github.com/coletdjnz)

[coletdjnz](https://github.com/coletdjnz)

opened [on Feb 26, 2025](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/12482#issue-2880454243)

Issue body actions

### Checklist

  * I'm reporting that yt-dlp is broken on a **supported** site
  * I've verified that I have **updated yt-dlp to nightly or master** ([update instructions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp#update-channels))
  * I've checked that all provided URLs are playable in a browser with the same IP and same login details
  * I've checked that all URLs and arguments with special characters are [properly quoted or escaped](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/wiki/FAQ#video-url-contains-an-ampersand--and-im-getting-some-strange-output-1-2839-or-v-is-not-recognized-as-an-internal-or-external-command)
  * I've searched [known issues](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/3766), [the FAQ](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/wiki/FAQ), and the [bugtracker](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues?q=is%3Aissue%20-label%3Aspam%20%20) for similar issues **including closed ones**. DO NOT post duplicates
  * I've read about [sharing account credentials](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#are-you-willing-to-share-account-details-if-needed) and I'm willing to share it if required



### Region

Any

### Provide a description that is worded well enough to be understood

It appears there has been a rollout for the WEB client where YouTube has removed the playback links for `adaptiveFormats` in the player response. This leaves only the SABR streaming URL for playback (which is what YouTube has been using for a while now)

SABR is a custom streaming protocol built by YouTube.

### Provide verbose output that clearly demonstrates the problem

  * Run **your** yt-dlp command with **-vU** flag added (`yt-dlp -vU <your command line>`)
  * If using API, add `'verbose': True` to `YoutubeDL` params instead
  * Copy the WHOLE output (starting with `[debug] Command-line config`) and insert it below

### Checklist

  * I'm reporting that yt-dlp is broken on a **supported** site
  * I've verified that I have **updated yt-dlp to nightly or master** ([update instructions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp#update-channels))
  * I've checked that all provided URLs are playable in a browser with the same IP and same login details
  * I've checked that all URLs and arguments with special characters are [properly quoted or escaped](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/wiki/FAQ#video-url-contains-an-ampersand--and-im-getting-some-strange-output-1-2839-or-v-is-not-recognized-as-an-internal-or-external-command)
  * I've searched [known issues](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/3766), [the FAQ](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/wiki/FAQ), and the [bugtracker](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues?q=is%3Aissue%20-label%3Aspam%20%20) for similar issues **including closed ones**. DO NOT post duplicates
  * I've read the [policy against AI/LLM contributions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#automated-contributions-ai--llm-policy) and understand I may be blocked from the repository if it is violated
  * I've read about [sharing account credentials](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#are-you-willing-to-share-account-details-if-needed) and I'm willing to share it if required



### Region

latvia

### Provide a description that is worded well enough to be understood

I record live stream from tiktok which requires login. I use cookie from browser. When i start recording in CMD is written:  
F:\yt-dlp>yt-dlp --cookies=cookies.txt <https://www.tiktok.com/@username/live>  
[tiktok:live] Extracting URL: <https://www.tiktok.com/@username/live>  
[tiktok:live] username: Downloading webpage  
[tiktok:live] 7585166667379510017: Downloading JSON metadata  
[tiktok:live] 7585166667379510017: Downloading JSON metadata  
[info] 7585166667379510017: Downloading 1 format(s): flv-origin  
[download] Destination: MF 2025-12-18 15_09 [7585166667379510017].flv  
[download] 389.93MiB at 152.30KiB/s (00:43:42)  
then came:  
[download] 708.92MiB at 162.71KiB/s (01:14:22)[download] Got error: HTTPSConnectionPool(host='pull-w5-sg01.fcdn.eu.tiktokcdn.com', port=443): Read timed out.. Retrying (1/10)...  
after it yt-dlp deleted file which was recorded and started to write video into new file.  
I.e. on every disconnect yt-dlp deletes file.  
I use newest nightly 2025.12.15.233113 version.

### Provide verbose output that clearly demonstrates the problem

  * Run **your** yt-dlp command with **-vU** flag added (`yt-dlp -vU <your command line>`)
  * If using API, add `'verbose': True` to `YoutubeDL` params instead
  * Copy the WHOLE output (starting with `[debug] Command-line config`) and insert it below

### Checklist

  * I'm reporting that yt-dlp is broken on a **supported** site
  * I've verified that I have **updated yt-dlp to nightly or master** ([update instructions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp#update-channels))
  * I've checked that all provided URLs are playable in a browser with the same IP and same login details
  * I've checked that all URLs and arguments with special characters are [properly quoted or escaped](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/wiki/FAQ#video-url-contains-an-ampersand--and-im-getting-some-strange-output-1-2839-or-v-is-not-recognized-as-an-internal-or-external-command)
  * I've searched [known issues](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/3766), [the FAQ](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/wiki/FAQ), and the [bugtracker](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues?q=is%3Aissue%20-label%3Aspam%20%20) for similar issues **including closed ones**. DO NOT post duplicates
  * I've read about [sharing account credentials](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#are-you-willing-to-share-account-details-if-needed) and I'm willing to share it if required



### Region

Japan

### Provide a description that is worded well enough to be understood

When downloading live streams, occasionally the download of video or audio stream stops, while the other stream that did not stop continue to be downloaded.

I saw this happens 3 times, and all of them were streamers who have bad internet connection or a poor pc that causes their stream stuttering.

In the output, downloding of audio stream stopped after frag 3497.

I included output around other usual errors, in case it matters.

### Provide verbose output that clearly demonstrates the problem

  * Run **your** yt-dlp command with **-vU** flag added (`yt-dlp -vU <your command line>`)
  * If using API, add `'verbose': True` to `YoutubeDL` params instead
  * Copy the WHOLE output (starting with `[debug] Command-line config`) and insert it below

# Allow downloaders other than FFmpegFD to support --download-sections #17518

## Description

[](https://github.com/garret1317)

[garret1317](https://github.com/garret1317)

opened [on Aug 23, 2026](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/17518#issue-5226394309)

Issue body actions

### Checklist

  * I've read the [**NO AI / NO LLM POLICY**](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#no-ai--no-llm-policy) and understand I may be blocked from the repository if it is violated
  * I'm requesting a feature unrelated to a specific site
  * I've looked through the [README](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp#readme)
  * I've verified that I have **updated yt-dlp to nightly or master** ([update instructions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp#update-channels))
  * I've searched the [bugtracker](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues?q=is%3Aissue%20-label%3Aspam%20%20) for similar requests **including closed ones**. DO NOT post duplicates



### Provide a description that is worded well enough to be understood

I made a custom downloader in my plugin. It can support `--download-sections` very easily, but core yt-dlp is hardcoded so you can only use `--download-sections` with FFmpegFD. It would be good if other FDs were able to support --download-sections as well.  
(to be clear, this issue is NOT about adding the functionality to other FDs, just making it _possible_ to add it)

[yt-dlp/yt_dlp/YoutubeDL.py](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/81ecd58b1394793e6da9998cc19fdb45657f1685/yt_dlp/YoutubeDL.py#L3484)

Line 3484 in [81ecd58](/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/commit/81ecd58b1394793e6da9998cc19fdb45657f1685)

|  if fd != FFmpegFD and 'no-direct-merge' not in self.params['compat_opts'] and (   
---|---  
  
  
it looks like the only thing that needs changing is this line in YoutubeDL.py. Instead of explicitly checking for FFmpegFD, it could check whether the fd declares itself as supporting `--download-sections`.

The external downloaders in external.py already have something like this in the `SUPPORTED_FEATURES` tuple. So we could add eg `Features.DOWNLOAD_RANGES` and check if `fd.SUPPORTED_FEATURES` has that? But that would mean having to add a `SUPPORTED_FEATURES` tuple to every FD, not sure if that's feasible or not

could add an attribute to the FD instead, and then just check with hasattr(), feels like a bit of a hack tho  
ofc could also check for a SUPPORTED_FEATURES attribute and then check the value

this may also be useful for the SABR PR [#13515](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/pull/13515) in future? :

>   * `--download-sections`
>     * Likely requires core changes to support sending data from downloader -> PP. The data is available but the underlying implementation of `--download-sections` is heavily built upon ffmpeg and will need to be reworked.
> 


needs more core changes ye but it would need this at the very least

### Provide verbose output that clearly demonstrates the problem

  * Run **your** yt-dlp command with **-vU** flag added (`yt-dlp -vU <your command line>`)
  * If using API, add `'verbose': True` to `YoutubeDL` params instead
  * Copy the WHOLE output (starting with `[debug] Command-line config`) and insert it below

## Description

[](https://github.com/aik099)

[aik099](https://github.com/aik099)

opened [on Mar 21, 2025](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/12686#issue-2938051665)

Issue body actions

### Checklist

  * I'm reporting a bug unrelated to a specific site
  * I've verified that I have **updated yt-dlp to nightly or master** ([update instructions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp#update-channels))
  * I've searched [known issues](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/3766), [the FAQ](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/wiki/FAQ), and the [bugtracker](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues?q=is%3Aissue%20-label%3Aspam%20%20) for similar issues **including closed ones**. DO NOT post duplicates



### Provide a description that is worded well enough to be understood

Video URL: <https://kinescope.io/2Hm8T6GCozMHvm8Rw64BgK> (has no audio adaptation set)  
Video MPD file: <https://kinescope.io/2Hm8T6GCozMHvm8Rw64BgK/master.mpd> or <https://kinescope.io/0ddf0adb-2819-4d07-99d7-663612e2e5c5/master.mpd>

Here are key moments to watch out in the below MPD file:

  * the `Representation > BaseURL` is an absolute URL to a file
  * the `Representation > SegmentList > Initialization @ sourceURL` and `Representation > SegmentList > Initialization @ media` attributes are written in a way that prepending `BaseURL` before them would produce a final URL



The Bug in the processing of `BaseURL`, which isn't prepended before any URL in the given Representation.

MPD file contents:
    
    
    <MPD mediaPresentationDuration="PT9.533S" minBufferTime="PT4.000S" profiles="urn:mpeg:dash:profile:isoff-on-demand:2011" type="static" xmlns="urn:mpeg:dash:schema:mpd:2011">

                    <BaseURL>https://edge-ams-1.kinescopecdn.net/3eda89a1-463a-4a4b-a8a1-22c353c83ed6/videos/8337640b-126d-4d11-9384-c465cc42f704/assets/b90ade6c-6974-4766-b103-37bf5040f5e1/720p.mp4</BaseURL>

  * I've checked that all URLs and arguments with special characters are [properly quoted or escaped](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/wiki/FAQ#video-url-contains-an-ampersand--and-im-getting-some-strange-output-1-2839-or-v-is-not-recognized-as-an-internal-or-external-command)
  * I've searched [known issues](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/3766), [the FAQ](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/wiki/FAQ), and the [bugtracker](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues?q=is%3Aissue%20-label%3Aspam%20%20) for similar issues **including closed ones**. DO NOT post duplicates
  * I've read about [sharing account credentials](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#are-you-willing-to-share-account-details-if-needed) and I'm willing to share it if required



### Region

_No response_

### Provide a description that is worded well enough to be understood

Sometimes YouTube seems to swap formats mid-stream. What I've seen very often is a stream starting with format 248 (vp9 1080p30) and then, after ~10 minutes, this format disappears and is replaced with 303 (vp9 1080p60).

When this happens, the DASH downloader ends up in a broken state: the video stream errors out, but it still keeps downloading the audio stream instead of stopping the whole download process and proceeding to postprocessing stage.

I have tried with SABR too, and the format swap still happens on YouTube side but SABR seems to handle this correctly - the full download stops and goes to postprocessing instead of continuing downloading just the audio.

I don't have verbose logs from yt-dlp directly because it's a bit hard to catch so I attached some logs from a program where I'm using yt-dlp's Python API, hopefully it's enough to understand the problem I'm describing. I will try to get actual verbose logs if I can catch it next time.

### Provide verbose output that clearly demonstrates the problem

  * Run **your** yt-dlp command with **-vU** flag added (`yt-dlp -vU <your command line>`)
  * If using API, add `'verbose': True` to `YoutubeDL` params instead
  * Copy the WHOLE output (starting with `[debug] Command-line config`) and insert it below

  * I've searched [known issues](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/3766), [the FAQ](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/wiki/FAQ), and the [bugtracker](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues?q=is%3Aissue%20-label%3Aspam%20%20) for similar issues **including closed ones**. DO NOT post duplicates



### Provide a description that is worded well enough to be understood

I've used yt-dlp together with a socks5 proxy, and got an unexpected error (full log at the end):
    
    
    ERROR: [requests] Unexpected error: EOFError: 4 bytes missing; please report this issue on  https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues?q= , filling out the appropriate issue template. Confirm you are on the latest version using  yt-dlp -U
    WARNING: [youtube] 4 bytes missing. Retrying (1/3)...
    

On the ssh process (that was providing port 1080) I got these error messages:
    
    
    channel 3: open failed: administratively prohibited: open failed
    channel 3: open failed: administratively prohibited: open failed
    channel 3: open failed: administratively prohibited: open failed
    channel 3: open failed: administratively prohibited: open failed
    channel 3: open failed: administratively prohibited: open failed
    channel 3: open failed: administratively prohibited: open failed
    channel 3: open failed: administratively prohibited: open failed
    channel 3: open failed: administratively prohibited: open failed
    channel 3: open failed: administratively prohibited: open failed
    channel 3: open failed: administratively prohibited: open failed
    channel 3: open failed: administratively prohibited: open failed
    channel 3: open failed: administratively prohibited: open failed
    channel 3: open failed: administratively prohibited: open failed
    channel 3: open failed: administratively prohibited: open failed
    channel 3: open failed: administratively prohibited: open failed
    

I then remembered that Alpine sshd disabled TCP forwarding by default, which explains the error message, but it may be a good idea to return a more specific error (pointing out that the socks server has rejected the connection request).
    
    
    % yt-dlp --proxy socks5://127.0.0.1:1080 'https://youtube.com/watch?v=redacted'
    [youtube] Extracting URL: https://youtube.com/watch?v=redacted
    [youtube] redacted: Downloading webpage
    ERROR: [requests] Unexpected error: EOFError: 4 bytes missing; please report this issue on  https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues?q= , filling out the appropriate issue template. Confirm you are on the latest version using  yt-dlp -U

    [youtube] redacted Downloading webpage

    WARNING: [youtube] 4 bytes missing. Retrying (2/3)...
    [youtube] redacted: Downloading webpage
    ERROR: [requests] Unexpected error: EOFError: 4 bytes missing; please report this issue on  https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues?q= , filling out the appropriate issue template. Confirm you are on the latest version using  yt-dlp -U

    [youtube] redacted: Downloading webpage

### Provide verbose output that clearly demonstrates the problem

  * Run **your** yt-dlp command with **-vU** flag added (`yt-dlp -vU <your command line>`)
  * If using API, add `'verbose': True` to `YoutubeDL` params instead
  * Copy the WHOLE output (starting with `[debug] Command-line config`) and insert it below

# Support wreq as alternative to curl_cffi that works on FreeBSD #16577

HTTP/TLS fingerprinting, curl_cffi, etc.[triageUntriaged issue](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues?q=state%3Aopen%20label%3A%22triage%22)Untriaged issue

## Description

[](https://github.com/dbohdan)

[dbohdan](https://github.com/dbohdan)

opened [on Apr 26, 2026](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/16577#issue-4330182519)

Issue body actions

### Checklist

  * I'm requesting a feature unrelated to a specific site
  * I've looked through the [README](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp#readme)
  * I've verified that I have **updated yt-dlp to nightly or master** ([update instructions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp#update-channels))
  * I've searched the [bugtracker](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues?q=is%3Aissue%20-label%3Aspam%20%20) for similar requests **including closed ones**. DO NOT post duplicates
  * I've read the [policy against AI/LLM contributions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#automated-contributions-ai--llm-policy) and understand I may be blocked from the repository if it is violated



### Provide a description that is worded well enough to be understood

One system I use yt-dlp on is a FreeBSD home server. A FreeBSD installation of yt-dlp is less capable than a Linux installation because curl_cffi doesn't support FreeBSD ([open issue](https://github.com/lexiforest/curl_cffi/issues/365)). The [wreq](https://github.com/0x676e67/wreq-python) library for Python is an HTTP client similar to curl_cffi. It can impersonate browsers with customizable TLS, JA3/JA4, and HTTP/2 fingerprints.

wreq is implemented in Rust and is easy to build on FreeBSD. I would like yt-dlp to support wreq as an installation option. This way FreeBSD users will have a curl_cffi-style HTTP client.

### Provide verbose output that clearly demonstrates the problem

  * Run **your** yt-dlp command with **-vU** flag added (`yt-dlp -vU <your command line>`)
  * If using API, add `'verbose': True` to `YoutubeDL` params instead
  * Copy the WHOLE output (starting with `[debug] Command-line config`) and insert it below



### Complete Verbose Output

### Provide a description that is worded well enough to be understood

On Rumble I always have to use list formats first, since every video since long get a new code for a given resolution.

So today this 403 error suddenly, worked fine 3 days ago.  
Something changed on Rumble.

Here is verbose listing  
[debug] Command-line config: ['-F', '-a', 'd:\dload\url.txt', '--verbose']

  * I've read about [sharing account credentials](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#are-you-willing-to-share-account-details-if-needed) and I'm willing to share it if required

### Provide a description that is worded well enough to be understood

Video option has up to 720p, and also 1080p if becoming a member of the site  
Link: <https://www.le.com/ptv/vplay/26937570.html> Download results in a 640x360 p video  
And this (limited to first 10 minutes, rest have to pay membership): <https://www.le.com/ptv/vplay/31637414.html> only downloads 266p for some reason

### Provide a description that is worded well enough to be understood

I'm logged in in this browser profile with a registered account with permission to access the given video. However, using --cookies-from-browser fails to grab authenticated API responses. I tried manually sending API requests and it responds successfully with only the `.ASPXAUTH` cookie being required (no csrf header necessary).

This means it's extra odd that authentication is failing here. The only reasonable conclusion I can think of is that cookies aren't properly being passed from `--cookies-from-browser` to the panopto API request. This is a panopto-specific issue, since `--cookies-from-browser` works perfectly fine with other platforms.

I'm unfortunately unable to share my account credentials in this case, but I'd be willing to offer any other assistance or contribution I can towards resolving this issue.

Issue body actions

### Checklist

  * I've read the [**NO AI / NO LLM POLICY**](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#no-ai--no-llm-policy) and understand I may be blocked from the repository if it is violated
  * I'm reporting a new site support request
  * I've verified that I have **updated yt-dlp to nightly or master** ([update instructions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp#update-channels))
  * I've checked that all provided URLs are playable in a browser with the same IP and same login details
  * I've checked that none of provided URLs [violate any copyrights](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#is-the-website-primarily-used-for-piracy) or contain any [DRM](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Digital_rights_management) to the best of my knowledge
  * I've searched the [bugtracker](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues?q=is%3Aissue%20-label%3Aspam%20%20) for similar requests **including closed ones**. DO NOT post duplicates
  * I've read about [sharing account credentials](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#are-you-willing-to-share-account-details-if-needed) and am willing to share it if required



### Region

Ukraine

### Example URLs

Unfortunately I can't provide a link

### Provide a description that is worded well enough to be understood

Previously Privio was supported but it is not anymore. Is it possible to have it back?

### Provide verbose output that clearly demonstrates the problem

  * Run **your** yt-dlp command with **-vU** flag added (`yt-dlp -vU <your command line>`)
  * If using API, add `'verbose': True` to `YoutubeDL` params instead
  * Copy the WHOLE output (starting with `[debug] Command-line config`) and insert it below



### Complete Verbose Output
    
    
    yt-dlp exited with code 1.
    
    WARNING: [generic] Falling back on generic information extractor
    
    ERROR: Unsupported URL: https://cercamon.privio.eu/viewing/52aabb0c-c438-43b9-a772-4419597a5e9e

Reactions are currently unavailable

# Windows filename sanitizer silently replaces ASCII "/" with U+29F8 BIG SOLIDUS #17549

Windows filename sanitizer silently replaces ASCII "/" with U+29F8 BIG SOLIDUS#17549

Copy link

Labels

[questionQuestion](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues?q=state%3Aopen%20label%3A%22question%22)Question

## Description

[](https://github.com/pcheek1991)

[pcheek1991](https://github.com/pcheek1991)

opened [on Aug 27, 2026](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/17549#issue-5270378235)

Issue body actions

### Checklist

  * I've read the [**NO AI / NO LLM POLICY**](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#no-ai--no-llm-policy) and understand I may be blocked from the repository if it is violated
  * I'm reporting a bug unrelated to a specific site
  * I've verified that I have **updated yt-dlp to nightly or master** ([update instructions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp#update-channels))
  * I've searched [known issues](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/3766), [the FAQ](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/wiki/FAQ), and the [bugtracker](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues?q=is%3Aissue%20-label%3Aspam%20%20) for similar issues **including closed ones**. DO NOT post duplicates



### Provide a description that is worded well enough to be understood

On Windows 11, yt-dlp silently replaces the ASCII forward slash "/" (U+002F SOLIDUS) in metadata used by an output template with U+29F8 BIG SOLIDUS.

The source title is:

Process serving Firestone (and/or)(or/and) Bridgestone on behalf of USAA per Patrick Jenks

The filename generated by yt-dlp contains:

Process serving Firestone (and[U+29F8 BIG SOLIDUS]or)(or[U+29F8 BIG SOLIDUS]and) Bridgestone on behalf of USAA per Patrick Jenks

Environment:

Windows 11  
yt-dlp master@2026.08.26.234438  
commit [`94eba4c`](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/commit/94eba4c156af080e87caf10cf8ffbea03bd17407)  
win_exe  
locale cp1252  
filesystem encoding utf-8  
output encoding utf-8

The behavior reproduces both when printing the generated filename and during an actual successful HLS download.

This is not an extractor failure. The source metadata contains the normal ASCII "/" character. The substitution occurs when yt-dlp constructs a filesystem-safe filename.

The substitution is problematic because U+29F8 is visually similar to "/" but is a different Unicode character. In a downstream Windows PowerShell 5.1 workflow, the UTF-8 bytes for U+29F8 were interpreted using a legacy Windows encoding and appeared as the mojibake sequence "a-section-sign-cedilla" rather than the intended character.

I understand that "/" cannot be used literally inside a Windows filename. The issue is the silent substitution with a Unicode lookalike rather than an ASCII-safe replacement, and the lack of an obvious warning or documentation describing this transformation.

Expected behavior:

Either clearly document the filename sanitization transformation from U+002F to U+29F8, warn when the substitution occurs, or provide a clearly documented ASCII-safe filename sanitization behavior for Windows.

Actual behavior:

ASCII U+002F "/" in the source title is silently transformed into U+29F8 BIG SOLIDUS in the generated filename.

The transformation also occurs with --skip-download and --print filename, demonstrating that it occurs in filename generation rather than during HLS downloading, ffmpeg processing, or filesystem writing.

### Provide verbose output that clearly demonstrates the problem

  * Run **your** yt-dlp command with **-vU** flag added (`yt-dlp -vU <your command line>`)
  * If using API, add `'verbose': True` to `YoutubeDL` params instead
  * Copy the WHOLE output (starting with `[debug] Command-line config`) and insert it below

  * I've read about [sharing account credentials](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#are-you-willing-to-share-account-details-if-needed) and I'm willing to share it if required



### Region

United States

### Provide a description that is worded well enough to be understood

I am attempting to save video from iQiyi, which I verified was a supported site.

The download fails with the error:
    
    
    [iq.com] 1phcwimx0ec: PhantomJS not found, Please download it from https://phantomjs.org/download.html
      File "yt_dlp\extractor\common.py", line 764, in extract
      File "yt_dlp\extractor\iqiyi.py", line 417, in _real_extract
      File "yt_dlp\extractor\openload.py", line 115, in __init__
    

I upgraded to deno, as recommended, some time ago. However, I did attempt to load a standalone version of PhantomJS to troubleshoot this issue. When I used the `--js-runtimes` flag to point to a directory for PhantomJS, yt-dlp flagged it as deprecated, and stated that it would not use it.

Not using deprecated software is good policy. I would not propose allowing PhantomJS as a solution. Ideally, there will be some fix to allow the iQiyi extractor to work with a JS runtime like deno that is currently supported.

I can see from the issues logs that other users are able to successfully use yt-dlp with iQiyi. If this is an issue with my installation rather than the code somehow, I am willing to take steps locally to remediate it. Please let me know if you have any additional questions or instructions. My system is a Windows 10 Home 64-bit OS, version 10.0.19045, with an Intel Core i7 processor.

  * If using API, add `'verbose': True` to `YoutubeDL` params instead
  * Copy the WHOLE output (starting with `[debug] Command-line config`) and insert it below

DO NOT post duplicates



### Provide a description that is worded well enough to be understood

I've recently been able to download age-restricted YouTube videos in 360p, even though the website offers 2160p versions. Is there a solution?

### Provide verbose output that clearly demonstrates the problem

  * Run **your** yt-dlp command with **-vU** flag added (`yt-dlp -vU <your command line>`)
  * If using API, add `'verbose': True` to `YoutubeDL` params instead
  * Copy the WHOLE output (starting with `[debug] Command-line config`) and insert it below

[bashonly](https://github.com/bashonly)on Aug 26, 2026

Workaround: use a [PO token provider](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/wiki/PO-Token-Guide) and the `mweb` client or `web_creator` client.

This is a side effect of [#17389](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/17389). The fix for that issue will also fix this one.

### Provide a description that is worded well enough to be understood

CBC Gem is missing the surround sound stream when downloading or viewing available qualities  
I'm wondering if this is possible anymore  
I found an old issue where the debug log references eac3 with 5.1 ([#11547](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/11547))  
When I run the command with that same URL I am missing an audio stream and the best available is stereo  
I have a premium account which I thought might be the issue, but it does not seem to be

[site-requestRequest to support a new website](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues?q=state%3Aopen%20label%3A%22site-request%22)Request to support a new website[triageUntriaged issue](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues?q=state%3Aopen%20label%3A%22triage%22)Untriaged issue

## Description

[](https://github.com/cnotin)

[cnotin](https://github.com/cnotin)

opened [on Aug 24, 2026](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/17528#issue-5239993747)

Issue body actions

### Checklist

  * I've read the [**NO AI / NO LLM POLICY**](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#no-ai--no-llm-policy) and understand I may be blocked from the repository if it is violated
  * I'm reporting a new site support request
  * I've verified that I have **updated yt-dlp to nightly or master** ([update instructions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp#update-channels))
  * I've checked that all provided URLs are playable in a browser with the same IP and same login details
  * I've checked that none of provided URLs [violate any copyrights](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#is-the-website-primarily-used-for-piracy) or contain any [DRM](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Digital_rights_management) to the best of my knowledge
  * I've searched the [bugtracker](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues?q=is%3Aissue%20-label%3Aspam%20%20) for similar requests **including closed ones**. DO NOT post duplicates
  * I've read about [sharing account credentials](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#are-you-willing-to-share-account-details-if-needed) and am willing to share it if required



### Region

_No response_

### Example URLs

  * Podcast show: <https://open.spotify.com/show/2IyZviDs8WLsVzCNamqhc2>
  * Podcast episode: <https://open.spotify.com/episode/45m6z2GQIIvert8LxSXcjt> -> <https://open.spotify.com/embed/episode/45m6z2GQIIvert8LxSXcjt>



### Provide a description that is worded well enough to be understood

Most Spotify podcasts cannot be downloaded, or are DRM protected, hence the current blocking of its domain: 

[yt-dlp/yt_dlp/extractor/unsupported.py](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/81ecd58b1394793e6da9998cc19fdb45657f1685/yt_dlp/extractor/unsupported.py#L34)

Line 34 in [81ecd58](/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/commit/81ecd58b1394793e6da9998cc19fdb45657f1685)

|  r'open\\.spotify\\.com',   
---|---  
  
However, the corresponding embed page for a podcast episode, sometimes contain the true URL of the file. For example, if you look at the HTML of <https://open.spotify.com/embed/episode/45m6z2GQIIvert8LxSXcjt>, you'll notice this:
    
    
    "passthrough":"ALLOWED","passthroughUrl":"https://traffic.megaphone.fm/GLT2458722524.mp3?updated=1670807113"
    

And indeed it points to a non-DRM MP3 file that can be downloaded.

Therefore, I suggest that, when `"passthrough":"ALLOWED"`, to offer downloading.

Here's a counter-example, for example this episode from a different Spotify podcast: <https://open.spotify.com/embed/episode/0DJKSCskUdVXJca83MsW53> which lacks passthrough:
    
    
    "passthrough":"NONE","passthroughUrl":""
    

### Provide verbose output that clearly demonstrates the problem

  * Run **your** yt-dlp command with **-vU** flag added (`yt-dlp -vU <your command line>`)
  * If using API, add `'verbose': True` to `YoutubeDL` params instead
  * Copy the WHOLE output (starting with `[debug] Command-line config`) and insert it below



### Complete Verbose Output

### Region

### Example URLs

<https://6abc.com/videoClip/19218676/>  
<https://6abc.com/videoClip/19218975/>

### Provide a description that is worded well enough to be understood

Many videos from abcotvs provide both 360p and 720p URLs, tagged 'mp4' and 'hqMp4' respectively. The current code only looks for the mp4. One complication is that some videos provide both URLs, but only the mp4 one is active (and 720p) and the hqMp4 link fails. The fix is to first probe for the hqMp4 link, and if that fails, fall over to the mp4 link.
    
    
    diff --git a/yt_dlp/extractor/abcotvs.py b/yt_dlp/extractor/abcotvs.py
    index ea5882b26..1c7e71972 100644
    --- a/yt_dlp/extractor/abcotvs.py
    +++ b/yt_dlp/extractor/abcotvs.py
    @@ -68,6 +68,15 @@ def _real_extract(self, url):
             if m3u8_url:
                 formats = self._extract_m3u8_formats(
                     video['m3u8'].split('?')[0], display_id, 'mp4', m3u8_id='hls', fatal=False)
    +        hqmp4_url = video.get('hqMp4')
    +        if hqmp4_url and self._request_webpage(hqmp4_url, "hqMp4", fatal=False):
    +            formats.append({
    +                'abr': 128,
    +                'format_id': 'HQ',
    +                'height': 720,
    +                'url': hqmp4_url,
    +                'width': 1280,
    +            })
             mp4_url = video.get('mp4')
             if mp4_url:
                 formats.append({

### Checklist
